newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Repco, three other stocks suspended.
newsitem.headline: Repco, three other stocks suspended.

text.p: Timber and gaming firm Repco Holdings Bhd and three other stocks were suspended on Monday at the companies' requests, an official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said.
The official said the other stocks that were suspended were property developer Berjaya Industrial Bhd, steel maker Ann Joo Resources Bhd and food products company S&P Food Industries (M) Bhd.
Repco's stock closed at 138 ringgit on July 11. A company official did not have any immediate comment.
Shares of Berjaya Industrial closed at 2.91 ringgit on July 11.
